name: tpl-precedence-3-nogoal
task: Do not take the key until you have moved the ball away from the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a single restriction — has_door_key may not occur before the first blocker_moved. The hard Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) captures exactly that; neither event is commanded (the key is only restricted, and moving the ball is only the condition of the 'until'), so no goal clause is needed and the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: Do not take the key until the ball has been moved away from the door
machine:

FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u1

(u0, !blocker_moved&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, blocker_moved) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
